values.note: 'Riverside Camping Rate 2025', single night: full hookup (30 or 50 amp) $43.85 + $6.15 tax = $50.00; pop-up $35.08 ($40 with tax) and tent $30.69 ($35 with tax) on the 20-amp electric/water tent and pop-up sites. Stay 6 nights, 7th free. Monthly $560 (30 amp) / $590 (50 amp) plus tax and metered electric; seasonal $1,650 a year plus electric.

values.note: 'Call to make your reservation' (276) 623-0340. A specific site is not guaranteed. Holiday rentals require a 3-night non-refundable deposit and 7 days' cancellation notice; other stays a 1-night deposit and 3 days' notice. River sites: 6 people, 2 tents, 2 vehicles, no visitors. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am.

summary: Operator pages (JS-rendered, read in the driver browser) confirm 50-amp full hookups, Apr 1 - Oct 31 season, phone reservations, laundry and camp store. Added fees $43.85 before tax (2025 rate sheet, $50 with tax) and 116 sites (94 full hookup + 22 tent/pop-up). Pull-throughs and showers not stated on the current pages; left as recorded.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: stored 'not waterfront', but the operator claims '2,000 feet of scenic river frontage along the North Fork Holston River', 'the best fishing in Virginia right from your campsite', and that the 22 tent/pop-up sites are 'most situated right on the river' (https://riversidecampground.org/). The RV full-hookup sites may not front the river; worth a look.
